title: Where Has Eternity Gone?
overview: An alternately sad and hilarious venture into middle America’s eccentric underbelly, Barney Snow’s “Where Has Eternity Gone?” spends 49 riveting minutes in the company of Gerald and Linda Polley, a Fargo couple who seem as docile as Pa and Ma Kettle but who claim to be in contact with the spirit of John Lennon and who “channel” new Lennon songs.
